item.title: Gunsmoke - Killer at Large
item.description: Festus flees Dodge after killing a medicine show sharpshooter in a gunfight.

item.title: The Waltons - The Thanksgiving Story - Part 2
item.description: Thanksgiving time on Walton's Mountain means a turkey shoot, a school play about early settlers, and the big meal. One year it also included a rekindled love affair and a life-threatening accident

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - Leopard on the Rock
item.description: When a dictator's plane is diverted to Hawaii as part of a plan to kill him, McGarrett must deal with the complex politics of the situation and protect the hated leader.

item.title: Matlock - Diary of a Perfect Murder (Pilot Part 2)
item.description: Atlanta lawyer Ben Matlock takes on the high-profile case of a television reporter accused of murdering his former wife. The case is complicated when Matlock's daughter, Charlene, develops feelings for the accused killer.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Glamorous Ghost
item.description: Eleanor Corbin pleads amnesia after police find her running and screaming through woods near her apartment building. Her loss of memory is of little help to her when she is later charged with murder.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - The Clothing Drive
item.description: Beaver's school is having a clothing drive and whoever brings in the most clothes will be awarded 1,000 school points. June, Ward and Wally round up all the old clothes they can find and put them in a box. However, next to the box are three good suits of Ward's that are to be cleaned, and, of course, Beaver mistakes them as items for the clothing drive.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Wally's Dinner Date
item.description: Wally has been constantly spending his time at Julie Foster's house and June suggests that he's old enough to take her out on a dinner date. Julie suggests a new expensive restaurant called The White Fox. However, during the meal Wally discovers that he forgot his wallet at home.

item.title: Toon In With Me - Pal-entine's Day
item.description: Toon In With Me - Pal-entine's Day

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 26: LEMRAS
item.description: Malloy and Reed drive up on a convenience store robbery in progress, which results in the suspects taking hostages. Later, they pull over a reckless driver who has just committed a heinous crime, learn about a new computer system designed to help them be more productive and finally thwart a group of serial burglars who use motorcycles.

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 115: Gang War
item.description: Officer Reed loses a robbery suspect while in foot pursuit. Afterward, he and Malloy try to help a priest prevent bloodshed between rival hispanic gangs, and then respond to a battered wife whose husband is very familiar to the officers.
